next.reason: 1985: on a successful OPEN 'the character set used to represent the data on the external media is the one referenced by alphabet-name-1', and the clause 'specifies the algorithm for converting the character set on the external media from/to the native character set'. §2023:13.18.13.4 GR2 sets 'the coded character set used to represent alphanumeric data on the storage medium' to alphabet-name-1 at OPEN, GR1 states the input/output conversion and GR6 its character-by-character replacement. The narrowing to alphanumeric data does not reach a 1985 program: 1985 §1985:VII.3.4.3 SR1 already requires all data in a CODE-SET file to be USAGE DISPLAY (as §2023:13.18.13.3 SR3 a) does), and with no SELECT WHEN clause (2023-only) §2023:13.18.13.4 GR3 converts 'all data items in each record'. alphabet-name-2 and national data are 2023-only. Same meaning.
